text: To model a smooth optimization oracle the authors compare a Debater Sampling condition (debaters sample at temperature 0.8, judge decodes greedily), a Combined condition using both the Reward Noise and Debater Sampling approaches, and a Control in which debaters and judge use greedy decoding with no further changes to the protocol.
title: Modelling a smooth oracle in debate: reward noise, debater sampling, combined vs control
